item.coloph: zhes gar gyi dbang phyug 'gro 'dul bstan gnyis gling pa (pas) gnas chen seng ge g.yu rdzong nas rin po che shog ser spyan drangs te/ phyis su me pho khyi lo pad+ma'i zab gter sbas pa'i nyer 'dab n+wa ga dbang po'i pho brang du mchis sa dben pa'i ri sul du mkha' 'gro'i brda ris la zhal bshus te yig rigs byed po 'gyur med thugs kyi bstan 'dzin g.yung drung ming gis bris pa'o//
